notes: Base building is optional. Settings › Base building: Automatic lays bases out for you and re-plans them as they grow and upgrade; Build my own lets you place every structure in the base Layout tab or in 3D. Changing anything on a base takes that base over, and Back to automatic hands it back. The clock pauses when you open a layout and stays paused until you press play

A library of 35 structures in seven groups (living, dining and welfare, command and medical, logistics, utilities, defense, aviation), each with its own 3D model: tents, B-huts, CHU blocks and hardened barracks; chow tent, sprung DFAC and full-service DFAC; showers, MWR, gym, PX and chapel; tent or hardened TOC, comms mast, aid station, clinic and combat support hospital; motor pool, maintenance hangar, conex yard, ammo berms, fuel bladders and bulk fuel farm; water point, generators, burn pit or incinerator; guard towers, HESCO, T-walls, bunkers, entry control point, C-RAM, Patriot and aerostat; helipads. Bigger structures need a camp or a major base

Bases scale: an FOB is a 20×20 grid (about 360 m across), a camp 32×32 and a major base 48×48 (about 860 m), with a T-wall line outside the HESCO at camps and up. Automatic plans put command north-west, living north-east, logistics south-west and fuel, ammo and the burn pit south-east, away from the billets, with towers along the wire and the gate on the south road. FOBs and young camps get tents; upgrades bring B-huts, CHUs and barracks, and major bases get bigger and more DFACs
A base now clears the mapped city buildings under its footprint, in the map and in 3D
Slower clock speeds: ½× and ¼× (40 minutes per game day) for following a fight closely
